name: Second Undergraduate Degrees

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In order to satisfy residency requirements for the second degree, students must complete at least two thirds of their upper division units at SFU.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students admitted into a second BA or BEnv degree will be required to complete a minimum of 45 upper division units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students admitted into a second BSc degree will be required to complete a total of 44 upper division units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Before pursuing a second degree, you must have approval from the advisor of the program and a complete list of courses required.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Second degree students must complete one upper division writing (W) course and one quantitative (Q) course.

sections.note:
Prior completion of lower division requirements for the major program may be required or may be waived at the discretion of the department.
Second degrees utilize various minor program combinations and are outlined below.

sections.title: Bachelor of Arts

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete two minor programs including a minimum of 45 upper division units in Faculty of Environment courses.

sections.note:
Choose two minors
archaeology geography sustainable development

requirements.title: Check with an advisor

sections.note:

climate change and society geographic information science resource and environmental management
